title: Fraction to Recurring Decimal
description: Convert a fraction (numerator/denominator) into a decimal string, identifying recurring sequences.
pseudocode:
1. result = (num < 0 ^ den < 0) ? '-' : ''
2. n = abs(num), d = abs(den)
3. result += (n / d).toString()
4. remainder = n % d
5. if (remainder == 0) return result
6. result += '.'
7. map = {}
8. while (remainder != 0)
9.   if (map.has(remainder)) insert '(', result += ')', break
10.  map[remainder] = result.length
11.  remainder *= 10
12.  result += Math.floor(remainder / d)
13.  remainder %= d
